title: Street flags

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Test identity at a distance because a street encounter offers little reading time.
strategic_value: Large vertical lettering and circular badges can identify the theater along a busy streetscape.
demonstration: A diagonal street photograph shows red badge flags and a white PUBLIC banner projecting from the building.
practical_value: Judge how emblem scale and banner proportions work above pedestrian level.

content_islands.name: Foreground flag
content_islands.spec: Place the large red flag with three badges against the blue sky.

content_islands.name: Street repetition
content_islands.spec: Retain the white wordmark banner and smaller flags receding along the facade.

reference_purposes.Expression: A diagonal street photograph shows red badge flags and a white PUBLIC banner projecting from the building.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph places the wordmark and venue badges on projecting street flags.
